N = 1, 2 or 4 active data lanes (dl_enable_x); PARA_NUM_LANES = 4 slices are instantiated. 2 x (N + 1) interconnect wires.
CIL-SFEN = Slave, Forward-only HS, Escape events only (triggers, ULPS), No reverse escape. With LPDT (OPEN K2) the data lanes become CIL-SFAN.
